pages.text: **Aura Chamber.** Runs Metallurgy's chamber recipes: three adamantine blocks give Health Boost, ignatius Fire Resistance, and so on, for the recipe's time while it has RF. Like the original it uses level I of the effect; set *use_amplifier* to 1 to use the recipe's level. Packs add more in *data/<pack>/fieldframe/aura/*: ingredient (an id or #tag), count, effect, duration in ticks, amplifier.
The Nullifier deletes for good. It does nothing until its Armed setting is on.

World devices act as the chassis owner: claim mods and a pack's world-action rules (FieldframeEvents.worldAction, actions *fish*, *collect_experience* and *apply_effect*) can stop them, and they then report PROTECTED.
